Defines Radix Themes CSS variables, component styles, and responsive utility classes.

# Purpose
This stylesheet defines the CSS theme system for a Radix Themes user interface and maps color tokens, spacing, type scale, radius, shadow, and motion values to CSS custom properties. It sets theme variants for gray color choices, scaling levels, radius modes, and dark or light color behavior, so the same UI parts can adapt to different visual settings through data attributes such as `data-accent-color` and `data-gray-color`. It also defines base styles, reset rules, font faces, and animation keyframes, and it includes component styles for UI parts such as `rt-Button`, `rt-Card`, `rt-CheckboxRoot`, `rt-Dialog`, `rt-Menu`, `rt-Heading`, and other controls. These rules support consistent layout, text rendering, interaction states, and responsive presentation across the user interface.
